parsed.visual_overview: A young female passenger in a cycle rickshaw converses with the older male driver on a busy street. The video ends with a 3D render of a smartphone displaying the Supernova AI app and an install button.

scenes.script_native:
Priya says: भैया, चांदनी चौक जाने का कितना लोगे?
Ramesh says: It will be around 100 rupees.
Priya says: 100 rupees तो थोड़ा ज्यादा है भैया।
Ramesh says: If you can't afford, then find some other rickshaw, please.
Priya says: अच्छा भैया, ये बताओ, I have been trying to make my boyfriend learn English, but I can't. फिर आपने कैसे सीख ली?
Ramesh says: वो मैं Supernova AI app use करता हूँ ना।
Priya says: Supernova AI? वो क्या है?
Ramesh says: इस app में एक AI teacher हैं। मैं रोज़ उनके साथ 10-15 minutes speaking practice करता हूँ। और वो सब कुछ Hindi में समझाती हैं।
Priya says: अरे वाह! पर ये AI तो महंगा होगा ना?
Ramesh says: बिल्कुल नहीं। ये offline coaching से सात गुना सस्ता है। और सिर्फ 30 days में improvement दिखने लगता है। तो अपने boyfriend को भी करवा दो।
Priya says: ज़रूर भैया। कैसे start करूँ?
Ramesh says: 1 crore+ users पहले से practice कर रहे हैं। बस install button पे click करो और Supernova AI download करो।
scenes.script_roman:
Priya says: Bhaiya, Chandni Chowk jaane ka kitna loge?
Ramesh says: It will be around 100 rupees.
Priya says: 100 rupees toh thoda zyada hai bhaiya.
Ramesh says: If you can't afford, then find some other rickshaw, please.
Priya says: Achha bhaiya, ye batao, I have been trying to make my boyfriend learn English, but I can't. Phir aapne kaise seekh li?
Ramesh says: Wo main Supernova AI app use karta hoon na.
Priya says: Supernova AI? Wo kya hai?
Ramesh says: Iss app mein ek AI teacher hain. Main roz unke saath 10-15 minutes speaking practice karta hoon. Aur wo sab kuch Hindi mein samjhati hain.
Priya says: Are waah! Par ye AI toh mehnga hoga na?
Ramesh says: Bilkul nahi. Ye offline coaching se saat guna sasta hai. Aur sirf 30 days mein improvement dikhne lagta hai. Toh apne boyfriend ko bhi karwa do.
Priya says: Zaroor bhaiya. Kaise start karun?
Ramesh says: 1 crore+ users pehle se practice kar rahe hain. Bas install button pe click karo aur Supernova AI download karo.
